unit.why: A single narrative, related in a letter from the tsaddik's grandson: R. Yosef Wolf hides the walking-stick of R. Avraham Moshe of Ostra as a prank, and three of his children die until the offended tsaddik is appeased.

stories.end_quote: מהארבעה ילדים שהי׳ לו. תסמר שערות ראש
stories.summary_en: R. Yosef Wolf, stepson of R. Zvi of Zhidachov, hides the stick of the awesome R. Avraham Moshe of Ostra in the beit midrash; three of his children die one after another, R. Zvi tells him to examine his deeds, he remembers the stick, but by the time the tsaddik is appeased the third child has also died, leaving only his daughter Mindel.
